odc_type: Memory inefficiency due to dense matrix representation
observation_summary: The application throws a java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space when performing curve fitting with a large number of data points.
reasoning_summary: The application encountered an OutOfMemoryError when processing a large number of observations because the weight matrix was being treated as a dense matrix. In the original implementation, the squareRoot method forced the conversion of the weight matrix into a full EigenDecomposition, which requires an n x n matrix representation. For a large number of observations (n), this results in an O(n^2) memory allocation that quickly exhausts the heap. The fix introduces a check to see if the matrix is already a DiagonalMatrix, allowing the square root to be computed in O(n) space and time without expanding it into a full dense matrix.
